_about: Medication interaction records: every entry cites the official document(s) it was taken from, records the mechanism only where the source supports one, and carries a severity state only where the cited wording supports it. Records are pairs of a medicine on this site with another medicine, a drug class or a named substance; the checker expands classes and combination products before matching.

interactions.effect: Amlodipine raises simvastatin blood levels, increasing the risk of muscle damage (myopathy and rhabdomyolysis).
interactions.mechanismNote: Amlodipine is a weak CYP3A4 inhibitor; simvastatin exposure roughly doubles
interactions.sourceWording: UK information states the doctor may prescribe a lower dose of simvastatin (usually no more than 20 mg a day) for someone taking amlodipine.
interactions.severitySource: NHS: Taking amlodipine with other medicines (simvastatin dose limited to 20 mg)
interactions.action: Official UK information: simvastatin dose limited to 20 mg daily with amlodipine; report unexplained muscle pain.

interactions.effect: NSAIDs such as ibuprofen can reduce the blood-pressure-lowering effect of losartan and, particularly with a diuretic or dehydration, cause acute kidney injury and high potassium.
interactions.mechanismNote: Loss of the renal prostaglandins that keep the afferent arteriole open when angiotensin II is blocked; the 'triple whammy' with a diuretic
interactions.sourceWording: UK information advises telling a doctor before taking anti-inflammatory painkillers such as ibuprofen with losartan; the BNF advises monitoring renal function.
interactions.severitySource: BNF: Losartan interactions (increased risk of renal impairment; monitor)
interactions.action: Official UK guidance: avoid regular NSAID use where possible; if used, kidney function and potassium are checked and the person stays well hydrated.
interactions.population: Higher risk in older people, dehydration, heart failure and chronic kidney disease

interactions.effect: Taking lisinopril with sacubitril/valsartan (Entresto), or within 36 hours of it, greatly increases the risk of angioedema (severe swelling of the face and airway).
interactions.mechanismNote: Both drugs reduce bradykinin breakdown (ACE and neprilysin inhibition)
interactions.sourceWording: The BNF lists sacubitril/valsartan as a contraindication; US information advises not taking lisinopril within 36 hours of it.
interactions.severitySource: BNF: Lisinopril contra-indications (concomitant sacubitril with valsartan)
interactions.action: Official information: contraindicated; a 36-hour gap is required when switching in either direction.

interactions.effect: Iodinated X-ray contrast can temporarily reduce kidney function, letting metformin accumulate and raising the risk of lactic acidosis.
interactions.mechanismNote: Contrast-associated acute kidney injury reduces metformin clearance

interactions.severitySource: BNF: Metformin cautions (withhold around iodinated contrast in renal impairment)
interactions.action: Official information: withheld on the day of the procedure and for 48 hours after in people with reduced kidney function; restarted when kidney function is stable.
monitoring: Creatinine and eGFR after the procedure
